newsitem.title: NEPAL: Nepal rupee steady vs dlr, NOC payment settled.
newsitem.headline: Nepal rupee steady vs dlr, NOC payment settled.

text.p: The Nepali rupee opened steady at 57.10/12 rupees per dollar on Wednesday, dealers said.
The market was inactive on Tuesday, they said.

State-owned Nepal Oil Corporation bought $12 million in the range of 57.12 rupees to 57.20 rupees per dollar for the import of oil products, a dealer said. "Banks supplied the dollars and there was no intervention of Nepal Rastra Bank (NRB), the central bank of Nepal," he said.
NRB quoted its rupee-dollar rate at 56.75-57.30 rupees per dollar.
Inter-bank call money rates opened at 3.00-4.00 percent on Wednesday, against its previous close of 3.00 percent, a dealer said.
